title: Future Proof: Mastering Change and Innovation

mc.q: Which one of the following is an example of a structural organizational change?
Which one of the following is an example of a technology change within an organization?
Which one of the following is an organizational "people change?"
Which one of the following is an organizational structure change?
o: the building of a new workshop
a new way to package chocolate cake

mc.q: Which one of the following is an organizational technology change?
The Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act is an example of which one of the following forms of environmental change?
Which one of the following is an internal force that can cause a company to make an organizational change?
Which one of the following is an external force that would cause a company to make an organizational change?
o: the naming of a new CEO
a widening span of control for managers

mc.q: To compete with rival company X, company Y changes its management structure. This is an example of ________.
o: an internal change causing an external change
an internal change causing another internal change
an external change causing another external change
an external change causing an internal change

mc.q: After a thorough company-wide self-examination, company Y decides to set up work teams. This is an example of ________.
o: an internal change causing an external change
an internal change causing another internal change
an external change causing another external change
an external change causing an internal change

mc.q: In organizations, people who act as catalysts and assume the responsibility for managing the change process are called ________.
Outside consultants generally try to initiate ________ changes than internal managers.
The "calm waters" metaphor envisions an organization as ________.
o: a large ship on a roiling sea
a large ship on a calm sea
a small raft on a calm sea
a small raft on a roiling sea

mc.q: The "white-water rapids" metaphor envisions an organization as ________.
o: a large ship on a roiling sea
a large ship on a calm sea
a small raft on a calm river
a small raft on a raging river

mc.q: The "white-water rapids" metaphor sees change as ________.
o: an unpleasant interruption of the normal calm

mc.q: The first step in Lewin's three-step description of the change process involves ________.
o: changing to a new status quo

mc.q: The final step in Lewin's three-step description of the change process is ________.
According to Lewin, which one of the following is a force that might overcome inertia and unfreeze the status quo?
According to Lewin, which one of the following is the objective of refreezing?
o: to promote movement away from existing equilibrium
to eliminate the need for future change
to direct behavior away from the status quo

mc.q: According to Lewin, which one of the following is the best way to unfreeze the status quo?
o: decrease restraining forces and increase driving forces
increase restraining forces and increase driving forces

mc.q: The goal in Lewin's "calm waters" metaphor is ________.
o: to change the current equilibrium state
to reach a state of constant change
to establish a new equilibrium state

mc.q: Today, Lewin's "calm waters" metaphor is increasingly thought to be ________.
o: an apt description of the current situation

mc.q: Which phenomenon in today's business climate has made the "white-water rapids" metaphor popular?
Writing laws to reward industries to reduce carbon emissions in an effort to combat global climate change can be best described as an example of which one of the following?
________ refers to the ability to combine ideas in a unique way or to make unusual associations between ideas.
________ is the process of taking a creative idea and turning it into something useful.
Some people believe that creativity is ________, while others think that creativity ________.
o: quickly and easily learned; is slowly learned
a genuine quality; does not really exist

mc.q: The first step in creativity involves ________.
o: seeing things from a unique perspective

mc.q: Which one of the following steps in the creativity process may take years before the idea finally "gels" and the next step occurs?
The moment when all prior efforts in the creativity process successfully come together is known as ________.
Using the systems model, managers can promote innovation by having the right ________.
mc.note: On the sheet A is also marked, B is circled. Textbook: creative people/groups are the inputs, but having creative people isn't enough – it takes the right environment to turn inputs into innovative outputs → people and environment.

mc.q: ________ variables are thought to promote innovation.
An innovative organization needs to tolerate ________ because creative ideas sometimes seem foolish at first.
Managers who want creative and innovative employees should ________.
o: not place much emphasis on goals
focus on means rather than ends
focus on ends rather than means
stress that there is only one path to a goal
mc.note: On the sheet B is also marked, C is circled. Innovative cultures focus on ends (goals) rather than means – there can be several paths to a goal.

mc.q: ________ actively support innovation and every step of the process that leads to innovative ideas.
All of the following are common personality characteristics of idea champions EXCEPT ________.
Samll community libraries are facing ________ from electronic devices such as Kindle and online reading services.

Majico, Inc., has a small team that works in a separate building on projects tangentially related to the company's main mission. They self-govern and have access to ample resources, most of it off-budget. They are free from the bureaucratic restraints placed on the "official" workforce. This team comprises a ________.
A company's workers asking to be able to celebrate Mexican holidays is an example of ________ force for change.
Labor strikes are an example of what change factor that may encourage a change in management thinking and practices?

open: In a short essay, define and discuss creativity and innovation in the workplace.
In a short essay, discuss the three sets of variables that have been found to stimulate innovation.
In a short essay, identify and discuss two external forces that bring about the need for change.
